title: Learning to Be Monitored: Causal Bounds and Intervention-Aware Post-Training Recipes for Chain-of-Thought Monitorability
abstract: arXiv:2610.31733v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring aims to detect potentially harmful behaviors in large language models (LLMs) from their CoTs. Intervention-based evaluations measure this property by asking whether a monitor can detect the role of an intervention from the CoT when the targeted behavior occurs, typically using minimal-criterion sensitivity ($\mathsf{TPR_{mc}}$) proposed by~\citep{guan2025monitoring}. However, a target behavior observed under intervention is not necessarily caused by it, and we show that this metric can overestimate how often a monitor detects target behaviors actually caused by the intervention. Specifically, we establish $\mathsf{TPR_{mc}}$ as an upper bound on this causal detection rate and derive a complementary lower bound, which provides a tighter evaluation framework for CoT monitorability. translated_title: 学会被监测：面向思维链可监测性的因果界与干预感知的后训练方案
translated_abstract: 思维链（CoT）监测旨在从大型语言模型（LLM）的思维链中检测其潜在的有害行为。基于干预的评估方法通过检验“当目标行为发生时，监测器能否从思维链中识别出干预的作用”来衡量这一属性，通常采用 Guan 等人（2025）提出的最低标准敏感度（$\mathsf{TPR_{mc}}$）指标。然而，在干预下观察到的目标行为并不一定是由干预引起的，我们证明该指标可能会高估监测器对“实际由干预引起的目标行为”的检出频率。具体而言，我们将 $\mathsf{TPR_{mc}}$ 确立为该因果检测率的上界，并推导出一个互补的下界，从而为 CoT 可监测性提供了更严格的评估框架。借助该框架，我们研究了能否通过训练使 LLM 的思维链变得更易于监测。我们首先构建了一个训练（后文截断）
tldr: 该论文指出常用的 CoT 监测评估指标 TPR_mc 只是因果检测率的上界并推导出互补下界，据此建立了更严格的 CoT 可监测性评估框架，并探索通过后训练方法使大语言模型的思维链更易于被监测。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the widely used CoT monitoring metric TPR_mc is only an upper bound on the causal detection rate, derives a complementary lower bound to build a tighter evaluation framework for CoT monitorability, and explores intervention-aware post-training recipes that make LLMs' chains of thought easier to monitor.
